skills.name: open_platform_authorization
skills.description: Open official OAuth authorization page in user's browser for third-party platforms (LinkedIn, Slack, Notion, Spotify, Linear, Jira, Discord, Twitter/X). ONLY invoke when user explicitly mentions an authorization word (authorize, auth, login, sign in, connect, link). For GitHub use github_authorize; for Google Workspace use google_authorize.

platform.description: Name or slug of the platform (e.g. 'linkedin', 'slack', 'notion', 'spotify', 'linear', 'jira')

skills.name: check_platform_connection
skills.description: Check whether JARVIS is connected to a third-party platform (LinkedIn, Slack, Notion, Spotify, Linear, Jira, Discord, Twitter/X). Returns ACTIVE, CONNECTING, or NOT_CONNECTED. Invoke when user asks if connected or connecting. For GitHub use github_connection_status; for Google use google_connection_status.

platform.description: Name or slug of the platform to check (e.g. 'linkedin', 'slack', 'notion', 'spotify')

skills.name: connect_platform
skills.description: Connect JARVIS to a third-party platform (LinkedIn, Slack, Notion, Spotify, Linear, Discord, Twitter/X). Opens authorization page only if not connected and user explicitly commanded authorization. For GitHub use github_authorize; for Google Workspace use google_authorize.

platform.description: Name or slug of the platform to connect (e.g. 'linkedin', 'slack', 'notion', 'spotify', 'linear')

reconnect.description: Force re-authenticating even if an active connection already exists

open_in_browser.description: Whether to automatically open the authentication link in the default browser (defaults to true)

skills.name: execute_platform_action
skills.description: Execute an action or query on a connected third-party platform (Slack, Notion, Linear, Spotify, Discord) via Composio. For GitHub and Google Workspace, use native tools (github_list_repositories, gmail_search, calendar_list_events, drive_search_files).

action.description: Action or goal to perform (e.g. 'get authenticated user profile', 'list open issues', 'send message to channel', 'list repositories')

arguments.description: Optional parameters or arguments to pass to the tool

skills.name: list_connected_platforms
skills.description: List all currently connected and active external platforms and integrations.

skills.name: disconnect_platform
skills.description: Disconnect or revoke access to a connected platform.

platform.description: Platform name or slug to disconnect (e.g. 'github', 'slack')

skills.name: composio_connection_status
skills.description: Check connection status for a Composio app or toolkit (e.g. github, gmail, slack, notion).

skills.name: composio_authorize
skills.description: Generate an authorization link to connect a Composio app or toolkit. Returns the redirect URL.

open_in_browser.description: Whether to automatically open the link in the desktop browser

skills.name: composio_search_tools
skills.description: Search available Composio tools and actions at runtime.

query.description: Search query describing the capability or app needed (e.g. 'github', 'weather', 'slack')

skills.name: composio_execute_tool
skills.description: Execute a Composio tool using its exact tool slug and arguments.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema
